bibl.title: Soterichus' Hymn to Isis: A Note on Wagner, Inscr. Graff. Doush II = SEG 38.1797.
bibl.seg: Ian Rutherford, Soterichus' Hymn to Isis: A Note on Wagner, Inscr. Graff. Doush II = SEG 38.1797.
bibl.note: S.E.G. XXXVIII, 1797. The hymn could be much later than Guy Wagner, Les Oasis d'Égypte à l'époque grecque, romaine et byzantine d'après les documents grecs. (Recherches de papyrologie et d'épigraphie grecques) = Bibliothèque d'étude. 100 (Le Caire, 1987) pp. 50-51, suggested, no earlier than about 270 AD.
